title: Trust Boundaries
description: The training-only record viewer accepts an object identifier without verifying that the requester is allowed to view that record. The dataset contains fictional people. Demonstrate the trust-boundary issue locally and record the evidence and fix.
learning_objectives: Inspect access decisions at the server

workspace_seed.readme.txt: Synthetic local-only records. No real accounts or personal data. Endpoint: /record?id=1001 or 1002.

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: Being signed in and being allowed to read every object are two different checks.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Inspect `app.py` and request `/record?id=1001` and `/record?id=1002` from localhost. Look for an authorization decision tied to an owner.

completion_explanation: You completed Trust Boundaries. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: Private local-only services; no public Internet route.
